titleEn: Law on the Establishment of the Secretariat of Civil Aviation

articles.en:
.
The Secretariat of Civil Aviation is hereby established, under the Office of the Council of Ministers and under the supervision of the Prime Minister.
Article 2.- The Secretariat of Civil Aviation shall have the duty to lead and administer the civil aviation sector of the Kingdom of Cambodia.

.
The Secretariat of Civil Aviation shall be led by one Under-Secretary of State.
Article 4.- The organisational structure and functioning of the Secretariat of Civil Aviation shall be determined by sub-decree.

- All provisions contrary to this Law shall be considered null and void.
Article 6.-
This Law is declared to be urgent.
Done at Phnom Penh, 24 [illegible] 1996, having respectfully submitted.
For the King’s signature; First Prime Minister, Second Prime Minister; Norodom Ranariddh, Hun Sen.
